name: blobhud
prompt: the viral blob tracking look: black and white camera with a red tracking box and crosshair locked onto whatever moves
notes: Tracks MOVEMENT, not brightness: a 160x90 copy is differenced against its previous frame, blurred so the scattered edges of one mover merge into one region, gained, and blobtrackCHOP boxes the largest moving region. gain1.brightness is sensitivity; tracker1.threshold ignores small flicker and tracker1.minarea ignores specks. The box snaps on while something moves and vanishes when it stops, or when most of the frame changes at once (a light switched). Do not lag the exports: x and y fall to zero when nothing is tracked, so a lagged box flies into the corner. One region, the largest mover; it does not recognise people.
